criteria.outcome: 2 sources used, each with a row. Licence check committed 2026-10-28 19:25:14 UTC, first download 2026-10-28 19:25:15 UTC, last 2026-10-28 20:00:24 UTC

criteria.criterion: Twelve monthly folds per series (36 fold runs), at least three months of training in the first fold
criteria.outcome: 33 fold runs (demand 12, wind 12, price 9), the first fold of every series trains on 3 months. The price has nine folds, not twelve, because its hourly report starts on 1 October 2025

criteria.criterion: MAE and RMSE of both baselines and both models per fold and overall in results/metrics_<series>.json and the README
criteria.outcome: present for all 33 folds of the 3 series and as means, the README carries the mean tables and the per-fold tables

criteria.criterion: Demand: LightGBM skill against the seasonal naive positive on at least 9 of 12 folds
Wind and price: skill per fold reported, the README says in words which model wins and where it loses
criteria.outcome: wind champion gru (positive on 11 of 12 folds, lightgbm better in 4), price champion lightgbm (positive on 8 of 9 folds, gru better in 2). Stated in words under Reading the results

criteria.criterion: A failure-hours table per series with at least one tag per row, the share of failure hours on holidays and clock-change days reported
criteria.outcome: all 1204 rows tagged. Holiday share of failure hours demand / wind / price: 8.4 % / 6.2 % / 1.8 %. Clock-change share: 0.0 % / 2.1 % / 2.1 %

criteria.criterion: MLflow: 36 fold runs, 6 aggregate runs, three registered models with the champion alias
criteria.outcome: 33 fold runs, 6 aggregate runs, 3 champion runs, 3 registered models with the alias champion. Three fold runs short of 36 because the price has nine folds

criteria.criterion: POST /forecast returns 24 timestamped values per series in under 2 seconds on CPU from a warm process
criteria.outcome: 24 values for every series, warm response at most 0.034 s, cold at most 0.053 s (FastAPI TestClient)

criteria.criterion: Two full runs with the same seed give identical LightGBM metrics and GRU metrics within 1 %
criteria.outcome: LightGBM MAE and RMSE identical on every fold: yes. Largest GRU fold-MAE difference 0.000 %

criteria.criterion: Missing data per month under 5 % for every month kept, dropped months listed
